findings.value: The Church of England's facilities listing shows a ramp, an accessible toilet and large-print material, but not where the ramp is or whether the route in is step-free. The church's own site has no access page. Hire and general enquiries go by email to hello@stjohnonbethnalgreen.church, and that is the place to ask about access.

evidence.quote: Accessibility Ramp Accessible toilet Large print
The church is available to hire for events. To make an enquiry, simply send us an email.

notes: Looked at the home page, contact, about, services, connect, art-classes and stations-of-the-cross pages in the sitemap, and the Church of England facilities listing; no access, FAQ or capacity page exists on the church's site and none of them mention entry prices, age limits or capacity. The home page describes a restoration project and an open-church session on the second Saturday of each month; no closure or access change is stated. No WebSearch result gave an access guide for this church, so access comes from the directory line only. Two searches used (of 8).
